content: In the letter substitution cipher used in this task, each encoded letter stands for a plain letter as follows: a means e, b means u, c means y, d means d, e means z, f means r, g means n, i means q, j means m, k means a, l means s, m means k, n means p, o means i, p means h, q means g, r means t, s means f, t means b, u means w, v means o, w means c, y means v, z means l. To decode a word, replace every encoded letter with its plain letter.
